A '''[[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]]''' was a member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], in which he held the rank of a guard captain.

==Behind the scenes==
This character was depicted on the "Rebel Guard Captain" card of the [[Champions of the Force (SWGTCG)|Champions of the Force]], the base set of the [[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]], which was illustrated by artist [[Mark Poole]].
